definitions.explanation: A room in a hospital where patients stay during their admission. Also used more broadly for any room where a sick person rests.

examples.japanese: {病室|びょうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何号室|なんごうしつ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What room number is the patient's room?

examples.japanese: {病室|びょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いった。
examples.english: I brought flowers to the hospital room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個室|こしつ}→個室：11535_koshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{病室|びょうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}める→休める：02437_yasumeru⟧。
examples.english: A private hospital room is expensive, but you can rest peacefully.

notes:
A standard compound: {病|びょう} (illness) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Very common in hospital-related contexts.

ROOM TYPES:
- ⟦{個室|こしつ}→個室：11535_koshitsu⟧: private room (single occupancy)
- ⟦{大部屋|おおべや}→大部屋：28441_oobeya⟧: shared ward (multiple beds)
- {二人部屋|ふたりべや}: double room
- {四人部屋|よにんべや}: four-bed room

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病室|びょうしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: to visit a hospital room
- {病室|びょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the hospital room
- {病室|びょうしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time in a hospital room
- {病室|びょうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧: the hospital room window

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病棟|びょうとう}→病棟：21002_byoutou⟧: hospital ward — the building or floor containing multiple rooms
- ⟦{診察室|しんさつしつ}→診察室：15666_shinsatsushitsu⟧: examination room — where doctors see patients for consultations
